newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: COLOMBO STOCK EXCHANGE LAUNCHES SCREEN TRADING.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBO STOCK EXCHANGE LAUNCHES SCREEN TRADING.

text.p: Sri Lanka President Chandrika Kumaratunga launched Colombo Stock Exchange's screen-based trading on Monday, exchange officials said.
They said trading began two hours late due to an elaborate inauguration ceremony attended by ministers, government officials, corporate chiefs and stock brokers.
There are 15 broking houses in Colombo who can now trade in stocks on-line, official said.
The stock exchange began testing the new system during trading hours in June.
